name: yugioh-trainer
description: Yu-Gi-Oh TCG training platform wrapping Project Ignis EDOPro

scripts.build: npm run build -w @yugioh/edopro-bridge && npm run build -w @yugioh/coach && npm run build -w @yugioh/windbot-engines && npm run build -w @yugioh/bot-lab && npm run build -w @yugioh/trainer
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @yugioh/edopro-bridge && npm run build -w @yugioh/coach && npm run build -w @yugioh/windbot-engines && npm run build -w @yugioh/bot-lab
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @yugioh/edopro-bridge && npm run typecheck -w @yugioh/coach && npm run typecheck -w @yugioh/windbot-engines && npm run typecheck -w @yugioh/bot-lab && npm run typecheck -w @yugioh/trainer && npm run typecheck -w @yugioh/bot-lab-app
